method.transitivePolicy: Do not create narratives from connected components. Pair labels distinguish same event, continuing storyline, parent-only context, and rejection. Mixed-topic clusters are explicitly marked.

evaluation.positiveDefinition: same specific event or same continuing storyline; broader-subject-only is parent context, not a child narrative
evaluation.caveat: In-sample, dataset-specific manual rules were informed by this audit; metrics are not held-out/generalization accuracy.
